experiments.description: Voiceover (offline Kokoro voices: Indian-English hf_alpha + American af_heart, af_bella, am_michael, am_fenrir, am_puck, rotated per video) on half of new videos
experiments.hypothesis: Narration lifts 48-hour views by at least 10% (owner's call, 2026-10-16)
experiments.notes: Started by the owner. maxDays 21 because uploads are manual until the YouTube audit. On keep: make Video.narrated true whenever the script has voice lines (drop the flag check in renderer/engine/video.py), make the writer always write `voice`, then remove this experiment. On revert: remove this experiment; the voice code can stay unused.
experiments.result: Closed without a verdict: the owner made every video voiced on 2026-10-17 (CLAUDE.md, hard constraints), so there is no off-arm. config/experiments.json no longer runs it.

experiments.description: A count-up or bar must land on the string Python makes from the number it counts to; its value is an @maths reference or 0, never typed.
experiments.evidence: Research 2026-10-18: v-20261017-04 (old engine) showed ₹6.5 L vs ₹6.4 L and ₹16.3 L vs ₹16.5 L for the same quantities. All 3 examples and v-20261018-01 pass the new check.

experiments.description: The render step gives a script with no narrator, or the previous video's narrator, the voice in NARRATOR_VOICES its format used longest ago (never-used first), and saves it in script.json.
experiments.evidence: Research 2026-10-19: am_michael narrated v-20261017-02, v-20261018-01, -02 and -03 (three in a row on one day); CLAUDE.md requires voices rotated per video. With current history the next Short gets am_fenrir, the next long video am_michael.

experiments.description: Long videos: the music bed about 4 dB lower and nearly silent under speech, so it only fills the pauses
experiments.hypothesis: Casual Finance's long videos (0.5-2.3M views) have no music bed at all (measured 2026-10-19: true silence between sentences, voice 35 dB over the floor; ours ~13 dB). A quieter bed keeps attention on the narration and lifts average % viewed.
experiments.notes: Started by the owner after the Casual Finance style study (improvement/style-study/2026-10-19-casual-finance.md). On keep: make QUIET_LEVEL/QUIET_DUCK the long-video default in build.py and remove the flag. On revert: remove the branch.

experiments.description: The writer's first line voices the on-screen hook (question or figure) within 8 words, no warm-up opener
experiments.hypothesis: v-20261018-02 showed 'Is your savings account keeping up?' at frame 0 while the voice said 'Quick question about your savings.' (1.8 s, no stakes). Saying the stakes in the first second keeps more viewers past the swipe and lifts 48 h views.
experiments.notes: Prompt-only (writer). On keep: fold the rule into generator/prompts/writer.md and add a check_script rule. On revert: drop the prompt.

experiments.description: The render step never gives the narrator the voice of a cast member who speaks in the same script (Sharma am_fenrir, Sikka af_bella); it takes the least recently used other narrator.
experiments.evidence: Research 2026-10-20: v-20261018-04 and L-20261018-01 had narrator am_fenrir while Sharma (am_fenrir) also spoke.

experiments.description: Prop 'stack': bills sit at half the old spacing and the figure rides just above the top bill, clear of a kicker and inside the frame under a punch.
experiments.evidence: Scout/Studio 2026-10-19: L-20261019-01 beat 'total' drew kicker and figure on top of each other, and without the kicker '$11,638' left the frame. Reproduced in stills before the fix (long and Short); after it both separate and the layout probe passes.

experiments.description: The number check ignores a leading m:ss / h:mm:ss timestamp on lines of a long video's description; numbers after it are still checked.
experiments.evidence: Studio 2026-10-19 had to run number-check before adding chapter timestamps, leaving the shipped description unchecked.

experiments.description: New maths kinds sip_stepup (yearly step-up vs flat SIP) and loan_prepay (prepay: lower EMI vs shorter loan), each recomputed in closed form by the number check; example examples/short_story_prepay.json.
experiments.evidence: Scout backlog (template/high): feed topics on step-up SIPs and EMI-vs-tenure prepayment could not be told with sip/emi. 5,382 random input sets: figures agree except 8 half-unit rounding edges on prepayments in a loan's last months (the number check rejects those; the writer picks other inputs).
